def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return []
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center
    cars.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Find the rightmost building
    rightmost_building = max(buildings, key=lambda p: p.right)
    
    # Filter cars that are to the right of the rightmost building
    right_cars = [car for car in cars if car.horizontal_center > rightmost_building.horizontal_center]
    
    # Further filter cars that are near the buildings
    near_cars = [car for car in right_cars if distance(car, rightmost_building) < 100]  # Adjust the threshold as needed
    
    return near_cars
